errorCodes.meaning: `to` is not after `from`, or more than 400 days after it.

EventId.description: Opaque identifier of an event: `evt_` followed by 16 to 64 base64url characters. Random, community-scoped, never reused (VTI-EVT-001).
EventId.title: EventId

EventLifecycle.description: `draft`: seen only by its hosts, changes freely, takes no registrations. `published`: seen by its audience, takes registrations; its roster setting is fixed. `cancelled`: will not happen; kept so registrants and their agents see it was cancelled, and takes no registrations. Whether a published event has ended is read from its time, never stored (VTI-EVT-004).
EventLifecycle.title: EventLifecycle

EventRef.description: What a receipt says of the event a registration belongs to: enough for the registrant's agent to show it as it was when the community answered (VTI-EVT-092).
EventRef.title: EventRef

EventTitle.description: A short name. Plain text; a reader MUST NOT treat it as instructions.
EventTitle.title: EventTitle

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

JSCalendarDuration.description: A non-negative duration in the subset of ISO 8601 JSCalendar uses: `P` then weeks or days, then `T` with hours, minutes and seconds, such as `PT1H30M`, `P1D` or `P2W`. No months or years. Used only for `When.duration`, which carries JSCalendar's own member and encoding verbatim; this family's own offsets are integers naming their unit (`ReminderMinutes`).
JSCalendarDuration.title: JSCalendarDuration

LocalDateTime.description: A local date and time with no offset, `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS`, as JSCalendar's LocalDateTime. Read in the event's `timeZone`.
LocalDateTime.title: LocalDateTime

PlaceSummary.description: A coarse hint shown with the event to its whole audience — `Central London`, `Online` — never the address. Plain text.
PlaceSummary.title: PlaceSummary

RegistrationStatus.description: Where a registration stands (VTI-EVT-032). `going`: has a place. `maybe`: has said maybe; holds no place. `pending`: awaits a host's decision. `waitlisted`: waits for a place, in order. `withdrawn`: the registrant withdrew. `declined`: a host declined a pending registration. `removed`: a host removed it.
RegistrationStatus.title: RegistrationStatus

identifier.description: The principal's identifier the entry concerns: the membership identifier the event was read as, or the notification's addressee.

readAt.description: `mine` only: when the VTA last read the event from its community.

schema.description: A client reads the principal's calendar across the trust contexts it has standing in: the events the principal registered for, as their communities answered them, and the events it has only been told of, as their notifications state them. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

contextIds.description: Only these contexts. Absent: every context the caller has standing in (VTI-CAL-002).

cursor.description: An opaque cursor from a previous response's `nextCursor`, for the same caller and filters; the VTA refuses one it did not issue.

from.description: Only entries still running at or after this instant. Absent: now.

limit.description: The most items to return, at most 200; the VTA chooses a default (50) and MAY return fewer.

to.description: Only entries starting before this instant. Absent: sixty days after `from`.

schema.title: VTA Calendar — List — payload
